后半夜，王建新又进了空间。

空间里亮堂堂的，五十亩地，牧草绿油油的，小麦和玉米也快成熟了。大毛它们五个趴在河边，看见他进来，摇着尾巴跑过来。五毛最欢实，扑上来就往他身上爬，爪子扒着他的衣服，舌头舔他的手。大毛稳当，蹲在他面前，尾巴在地上扫来扫去。二毛三毛四毛围着他转圈，哼哼唧唧的。

王建新从冰库里拿出几块冻肉，切成大块，扔给它们。五条狗扑上去就吃，吃得呜呜叫。大毛叼着最大那块跑到一边去，二毛三毛四毛围着剩下的抢，五毛挤不进去，急得直哼哼。王建新又拿了一块，单独扔给五毛。五毛叼着肉跑到角落里，尾巴摇得像风车。

小狐狸也长大了好多，从沙发上跳下来，跑到他脚边，蹭了蹭他的裤腿。王建新弯腰把小狐狸抱起来，小家伙毛茸茸的，脸圆圆的，眼睛亮亮的。虽然还是灰不溜秋的，但养得好了，毛发油亮，摸着滑溜溜的。

他抱着小狐狸走到河边，盘腿坐下。小狐狸蜷在他怀里，找了个舒服的姿势，眯着眼睛。王建新闭上眼睛，开始运转功法。灵力在体内流转，液态的灵力从丹田出发，沿着经脉走向全身。炼气四层的境界已经稳固了，但每天还是要修炼，不进则退。

小狐狸趴在他怀里，安安静静的，不吵不闹。它好像能感受到王建新修炼时的灵气，眯着眼睛，呼吸变得很轻很慢，像是在跟着一起修炼。

灵气运转了一个大周天，又一个大周天。丹田里的灵力池平静如镜，倒映着空间里柔和的光。

王建新结束了修炼。他睁开眼睛，吐出一口浊气，把小狐狸放在沙发上，摸了摸大毛的头，出了空间，天蒙蒙亮了。

从耳房出来，他端着洗脸盆，自来水池在中院，是公用的，几家邻居共用一个水龙头。王建新接了半盆水，蹲在池子边上刷牙洗脸。

也有早起的邻居，端着盆过来接水，互相打着招呼。

“建新起这么早啊？”中院的刘婶端着盆走过来。

“刘婶早，习惯了，在部队养成的。”

“当兵好，有规矩。”刘婶接了水，端着盆走了。

洗漱完毕，回到后院。大家全都起来了。父亲在院子里擦拭着自行车。母亲在厨房里忙活，小米粥已经熬上了，咕嘟咕嘟地冒着泡。大嫂在屋里给妞妞穿衣服，妞妞不肯穿，扭来扭去，咯咯地笑。小妹丽丽蹲在地上拿根棍子逗蚂蚁。二哥提着桶去中院打水，倒进堂屋的水缸里。

“吃饭了——”母亲在厨房里喊了一声。

一家人围坐在堂屋里。小米粥熬得浓稠，二合面馒头蒸得暄软，咸菜是自家腌的萝卜条，淋了几滴香油。大嫂给妞妞盛了小半碗粥，吹凉了，一勺一勺地喂。小妹丽丽自己端着碗，呼噜呼噜地喝，喝完了还舔碗。

王建新吃了两个馒头，喝了两碗粥。母亲看他吃得多，脸上全是笑，又给他夹了一筷子咸菜。

吃过早饭，父亲、二哥、大嫂都去上班了。父亲推着他那辆旧自行车出了门，二哥跟在后面，两人一前一后走了。大嫂抱着妞妞亲了一口，放下，拎着布包也走了。

王建新和母亲收拾完碗筷。母亲擦着桌子，说：“三儿，今天没事，带丽丽和妞妞出去转转吧。妞妞在家待着也闷。”

“行。”王建新抱起妞妞，领上妹妹，跟母亲说了一声，便出门了。

出了大杂院，出了胡同，来到大街上。

早晨的太阳已经升起来了，金色的阳光洒在灰砖墙上，洒在柏油路面上。街上行人行色匆匆，骑自行车的、走路的、等公交车的，都赶着去上班。这时候的人们精神饱满，头发乌黑。王建新注意到一个现象——这个年月，秃顶的少见。街上走过去的男人，不管年轻的还是上了年纪的，头发都挺浓密。不知道是因为吃的东西天然，还是因为生活规律。

Later in the night, Wang Jianxin entered the space again.

The space is bright, there are fifty acres of land, the pasture is lush and green, and the wheat and corn are about to mature.Da Mao and the other five were lying by the river. When they saw him coming in, they ran over wagging their tails.Wumao was the most cheerful. She jumped up and crawled on top of him, clawing at his clothes and licking his hands with her tongue.Da Mao was steady, squatting in front of him, his tail sweeping back and forth on the ground.The two, three, and four hairs circled around him, humming.

Wang Jianxin took out a few pieces of frozen meat from the freezer, cut it into large pieces, and threw it to them.The five dogs pounced on it and ate it, whining and yelping as they ate.Da Mao ran to the side with the biggest piece in his mouth, and grabbed the rest with his two cents, three cents and four cents. Five cents couldn't squeeze in, so he groaned in anxiety.Wang Jianxin took another piece and threw it to Wu Mao alone.Wu Mao ran to the corner with the meat in his mouth, his tail wagging like a windmill.

The little fox has grown up a lot. He jumped off the sofa, ran to his feet, and rubbed his trouser legs.Wang Jianxin bent down and picked up the little fox. The little guy was furry, with a round face and bright eyes.Although it is still gray and gray, it has been well cared for, and its hair is shiny and slippery to the touch.

He carried the little fox to the river and sat down cross-legged.The little fox curled up in his arms, found a comfortable position, and squinted his eyes.Wang Jianxin closed his eyes and started to run the technique.The spiritual power flows in the body, and the liquid spiritual power starts from the Dantian and travels along the meridians to the whole body.The realm of the fourth level of Qi refining has been stabilized, but you still have to practice every day. If you don't advance, you will retreat.

The little fox lay in his arms, quietly and without making any noise.It seemed to be able to feel the spiritual energy of Wang Jianxin's practice. It squinted its eyes and breathed very softly and slowly, as if it was practicing along with him.

The spiritual energy circulated for one great week and then another.The spiritual energy pool in Dantian is as calm as a mirror, reflecting the soft light in the space.

Wang Jianxin ended his practice.He opened his eyes, exhaled a breath, put the little fox on the sofa, and touched Da Mao's head. When he left the space, the sky became bright.

Coming out of the ear room, he was carrying a washbasin. The water basin was in the middle courtyard and was public. Several neighbors shared the same faucet.Wang Jianxin took half of the basin of water and squatted by the pool to brush his teeth and wash his face.

There were also neighbors who got up early, came over with basins to collect water, and greeted each other.

"Is Jianxin getting up so early?" Aunt Liu from the middle courtyard came over with a basin.

"Aunt Liu, I'm used to it. I developed it in the army."

"It's good to be a soldier, there are rules." Aunt Liu took the water and left with the basin.

After washing up, go back to the backyard.Everyone got up.My father was wiping his bicycle in the yard.Mother was busy in the kitchen, and the millet porridge was already boiling and bubbling.The sister-in-law was dressing Niu Niu in the house, but Niu Niu refused to wear it and twisted around, giggling.The little girl Lili squatted on the ground and teased the ants with a stick.The second brother carried a bucket to the central courtyard to fetch water and poured it into the water tank in the main room.

"It's time to eat-" Mother shouted from the kitchen.

The family sat around the main room.The millet porridge is cooked thickly, the Erhe noodle steamed buns are steamed until soft, and the pickles are homemade pickled radish strips with a few drops of sesame oil.The sister-in-law gave Niu Niu half a bowl of porridge, blew it to cool down, and fed her one spoonful at a time.The little girl Lili held the bowl by herself, drank slurpingly, and even licked the bowl after finishing the drink.

Wang Jianxin ate two steamed buns and drank two bowls of porridge.His mother smiled when she saw how much he ate, and gave him another chopstick of pickles.

After breakfast, my father, second brother, and sister-in-law all went to work.The father pushed his old bicycle out the door, followed by the second brother, and the two left one after the other.The sister-in-law hugged Niuniu, kissed her, put her down, and left with the cloth bag.

Wang Jianxin and his mother finished clearing the dishes.The mother wiped the table and said, "San'er, you have nothing to do today. Let's take Lili and Niu Niu out for a walk. Niu Niu is bored staying at home."

"Okay." Wang Jianxin picked up Niuniu, took his sister, said to his mother, and went out.

Out of the courtyard, out of the alley, and onto the street.

The morning sun has risen, and its golden rays shine on the gray brick walls and the asphalt road.Pedestrians on the street are in a hurry, cyclists, walkers, and people waiting for buses are all rushing to go to work.At this time, people are full of energy and their hair is black.Wang Jianxin noticed a phenomenon - in this day and age, baldness is rare.The men walking by on the street, whether young or old, all have thick hair.I don’t know if it’s because of the natural food I eat, or because of my lifestyle.
